item.title: Contact Us
item.dc:creator: feinifuh
item.content:encoded:
To use forms you can install the Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin or use Jetpack forms feature. After the installation of the plugin just create a new form via the Contact Form 7 settings page and copy/paste the shortcode into a page or post. If you have already installed Jetpack you can activate the Jetpack Contact Form feature under Appearance → Jetpack and then just add your form via the new “Add Contact Form” button at the top of your text editor field. Here is an example of the Jetpack contact form:

item.dc:creator: feinifuh
item.content:encoded:
Try Beautiful Healthy Food Today

To create a Menus page just copy and paste the HTML code from this code example page into any page (using the text editor) with the Menu Page template. Now you only have to include your own content.

Breakfast

Summer Açaí Superfood Breakfast Bowl

Amazing Açaí smoothie bowl with raw cacao nibs and fresh fruits of the season. €15

Blueberry Waffles with Cashew Cream

Fresh, home-made waffles with raw, vegan Cashew Cream (secret recipe). €12

Raw Chocolate Smoothie

A yummy treat to get your day started, you don't want to stay without it. €8

The Best Birchler Muesli Bowl in Town

Our special coconut yogurt, organic birchler muesli cereal and fresh fruits on the side. €12

Raw, Vegan Pizza with rucola and Parmesan

» Summer Special « Try out our amazing summer special, this raw pizza with leave you wanting for more. €18

Get inspired by the exotic cuisine of Sri Lanka with our beautiful, creative lunch curry special. €15

Super Green Salad

Need a green energy booster to get you through the day? Then try our super salad with lots of fresh, organic greens and spicy tumeric, lemon dressing. €16

Raw Zucchini Zoodles Bowl

You just have to try this fresh, Italian yumminess of raw Zucchini noodles with the best tomato basil sauce you will ever find. €19

item.title: Testimonials
item.dc:creator: feinifuh
item.content:encoded:
Do you want to show your greatest feedback to your website visitors? You can easily add a testimonials page to your website, using the "Testimonials Page" template and some especially prepared HTML code.

Ellen Bauer

The food was amazing, I want to eat the raw pizza and nacho plate every day! The green smoothies are also a real treat.

Lilli Baker

I come here multiple times a week for lunch with my colleagues and we all love the food and the fresh juices and smoothies.

Robert Miller

Thanks so much for this amazing lunch. Please also open on Sundays, I want to eat at your place every day :)

Manuel

I can't even describe how beautiful, fresh and creative this food is, you just have to try yourself. Don't miss out!

Luna

We came in for breakfast and it was sooo good. You have to try the Açaí smoothie bowl, it's like the best thing I ever ate. So fresh and tasty!

Krissy

Thanks so much to the Black Walnut team for hosting our little girl's night out last week. We had a blast and definitely will come back!

Julia Jones

I ate here with my family (also non vegans) last week and everybody just loved the food. A real hit, will go again!

Ally Smith

Please try this food, it will literally change your whole universe. I won't say anything else, just try yourself!

Matthew

I love the Buddha Bowl, the Nachos and the salads here, sooo yummy. The Raw Chocolate Smoothie is also amazing! Yum, I will maybe go there later, I'm hungry now :)

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: feinifuh
item.content:encoded:
Hello and Welcome to the Black Walnut live demo! Black Walnut is a beautiful, fresh little business theme for small businesses like cafés, restaurants, yoga schools, photographers or freelancers. You can easily set up a Front page with one big or four small images and add text slogans to the images as well. You can also create a minimal, two-column blog, an About and contact page or add pages for your menu or testimonials.

We love to create things, try out new ways, always stay positive and excited for new adventures.

And you can add some further text here and also use the "justify" CSS class to add justified text blocks. With the additional CSS class of "blue" or "red" you can easily add colored texts as well.
